description: Mark the claimed Goal done and release it, once its Outcome is true and its Tasks are done, released or dropped (not with a helper, waiting on the Developer or only checked). While the Developer still has hand tests (add_hand_test) to mark, the Goal is released as built and waiting on their tests instead: it finishes by itself when they mark the last one, and a failure reopens it with a new Task. unmarked_hand_tests_ok finishes it now, only when the Developer says to finish anyway. If more work turns up later, claim_goal reopens it.

goal.description: The claimed Goal's ID, such as 'ship-oauth-login'. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.

project.description: Another project's plan to use instead of this one's: its name or ID on the dashboard, or its folder's full path. Changes there are marked as made from this project. Leave out for this project.

unmarked_hand_tests_ok.description: Finish now even though some hand tests are still not marked by the Developer. Only when the Developer says to finish anyway.

name: complete_goal
title: Complete Goal
